- Bluetooth: new BLE spam detector. It spots pairing pop-up floods (Apple AirPods and Nearby Action, the iOS 17 crash frame, Google Fast Pair, Microsoft Swift Pair, Samsung Easy Setup, Lovespouse), tells them from real accessories, says why it raises an alert, keeps a history, and lists the Flipper Zeros in range. Detection ideas contributed by Melvin Olivet
- SDR: new Listen tool. Tap or drag on a 2 MHz spectrum to tune, and hear WFM, NFM, AM, USB or LSB, with volume, squelch and preset stations
- SDR: RTL-SDR dongles (R820T / R828D tuner), Airspy and ADALM-Pluto can now be used next to the HackRF (new, not yet tested on real hardware: feedback welcome). Tools a radio cannot run say so
- Bluetooth: no more positive signal levels. Android reports 127 when it has no level, and it is now ignored; wardriving also drops the levels already stored this way
